prompt:
The multicolumn features section in sections/multicolumn-features-wrap.liquid has finished markup, but its {% schema %} JSON is broken. Rewrite only the JSON inside the single top-level {% schema %} block and leave the markup untouched. The markup has several optional wrappers, each with its own setting: - Each column is wrapped in an only when its block setting `link` is present, so `link` must be a url setting. - The media
appears only when the block's `image` (an image_picker) is set. - The section button appears only when both `button_label` and `button_link` are present. These two settings must have no default, so the button is hidden until a merchant fills them in. The final schema must be exactly the following, with keys at each level in this order and no other keys anywhere. Top level: - "name": "Multicolumn" - "tag": "section" - "class": "section-multicolumn" - "max_blocks": 6 (a number) - "settings": an array of five entries, in this order: 1. type "text", id "title", label "Heading", default "Why shop with us" 2. type "range", id "columns_desktop", label "Columns on desktop", min 1, max 4, step 1, default 3 (all numbers) 3. type "header", content "Button" (only these two keys) 4. type "text", id "button_label", label "Button label" (no default key) 5. type "url", id "button_link", label "Button link" (no default key) - "blocks": one block definition with type "column" and name "Column". Its settings are, in this order: 1. type "image_picker", id "image", label "Image" 2. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Column" 3. type "richtext", id "text", label "Description", default "

Pair text with an image to focus on your chosen product.

" 4. type "url", id "link", label "Link" - "presets": one preset with name "Multicolumn" and blocks [{"type":"column"},{"type":"column"},{"type":"column"}] Key order inside each setting: type, then id, then label, then (range only) min, max, step, then default where one is present. Header entries are ordered type, content. Inside the block definition: type, name, settings. Inside the preset: name, blocks. Change only sections/multicolumn-features-wrap.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
